card.name: Start of pentetate and penicillin names
card.fires_on: The opening piece "pent" or "pen" in drug names, where the rest of the word follows. It is mainly seen in technetium Tc 99m pentetate and in penicillin or benzylpenicillin.

modes.label: Pentetate after technetium
modes.description: The start of pentetate right after Technetium Tc 99m in radiopharmaceutical labels.
modes.example: Hypersensitivity reactions, including anaphylaxis, have been reported during post-approval diagnostic use of Technetium Tc 99m<< pent>>etate injection.

modes.label: Penicillin in beta-lactam lists
modes.description: The start of penicillins after "e.g.," in lists of beta-lactam antibiotics, or inside benzylpenicillin.
